build: python -c "import subprocess as s,tomllib,json;ls=lambda *p:s.check_output(['git','ls-files',*p],text=True).splitlines();py=ls('*.py');assert py,'no python files found';[compile(open(p,'rb').read(),p,'exec') for p in py];tm=ls('*.toml');assert tm,'no toml files found';[tomllib.load(open(p,'rb')) for p in tm];js=ls('*.json');assert js,'no json files found';[json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8')) for p in js];print('build: compiled',len(py),'python, parsed',len(tm),'toml,',len(js),'json')" && powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$f=@(git ls-files '*.ps1');if($f.Count -eq 0){exit 2};$bad=0;foreach($p in $f){$e=$null;[void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path $p).Path,[ref]$null,[ref]$e);foreach($x in $e){Write-Host ($p+':'+$x.Extent.StartLineNumber+': '+$x.Message);$bad++}};Write-Host ('build: parsed '+$f.Count+' ps1 with Windows PowerShell '+$PSVersionTable.PSVersion+', errors '+$bad);if($bad){exit 1}"
test: uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt python -m pytest scripts/tests -q
health: python -c "import subprocess as s,sys;f=s.check_output(['git','ls-files','*.sh','hooks/*','.githooks/*'],text=True).splitlines();sys.exit(2 if not f else s.call(['uvx','--from','shellcheck-py==0.10.0.1','shellcheck',*f]))" && python -c "import subprocess as s,sys;f=s.check_output(['git','ls-files','.github/workflows/*.yml','templates/.github/workflows/*.yml','workflows/*.yml'],text=True).splitlines();sys.exit(2 if not f else s.call(['go','run','github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.7','-shellcheck=','-pyflakes=','-oneline',*f]))"
